behavioral_source_checks.detail: choose_rollout receives only actor, fitted planner, public clock and READ budget. Its root mass is actor.current. Actual EpisodeOwner passes only encoded paid/missing/reset observations; latent state, hidden endpoint cost and final score do not enter actor choice. full_clock true mass/world is confined to evaluator transitions, branching weights and rewards.

Every hypothetical observed successor clones complete current/hidden actor state before step. Registered HXFilter and recurrent models share only fixed parameters and inference transition caches. The current actor is not updated by hypothetical branches.

Each first-action score follows original fitted planner.choose on every future actual actor state. Documentation and RESULT explicitly deny that these scores are Qpi of the new receding repair or a true-world improvement guarantee.

Actual worker recomputes choose_rollout on every nonterminal paid prefix. full_clock follow invokes supplied selector anew at every successor, and repaired arms pass choose_rollout rather than the original planner. Thus full_clock values correspond to actual receding policies.

STOP0/STOP1 remain legal at the initial positive horizon; terminal choices have reward without continuation fees. RESET applies R before elapsed transition Q. READ charges successor-state-dependent fee before observation branching. Latency/reset fees use entering branch mass, and all emission branches use unnormalized mass. These agree with EpisodeOwner execution ordering.

A/B share ordinary checkpoint, C/D share HX checkpoint, and B_prime/D_prime use the same actor-aware repair procedure and shared fitted world. Ordinary family selection is inherited frozen validation choice. Fresh tape seeds and all 27 clock schedules are paired across the six arms. All original and repaired factorial/direct contrasts are reported.

Uniform Cartesian product over the three registered intervals at each of three positions yields 27 clocks per domain. For each arm the evaluator enumerates hidden/observed branch mass without latent/tape sampling, preserves full actor hidden state, checks leaf mass and records expected action counts. This is finite-model expectation up to floating-point matrix and arithmetic error.

Each arm receives a fresh single-thread process, planner and restored model. Actual planner cache persists across 128 episodes within that worker. Hypothetical controller branches may legitimately populate their actor transition caches as part of charged controller work. Diagnostic planner/model runs afterward and independently. Whole wait4 time includes imports, verification, setup, actor, simulated owner, diagnostic replay, evidence and exit. The 16 full-clock workers are a separate total. Nested components must not be added again to their process receipts.

Six tests cover fitted HX Bayes equivalence/ties, manually computed real recurrent READ tail and no actor mutation, local first-action score inequality, STOP/action legality with exhausted clock/budget, original policy expectation versus independent q_pi, and selector reinvocation after observation. No reviewer claim that these tests have run or passed.

findings.original_problem: Repair-only reference action_values reused the actual planner LRU during timed episodes, potentially warming or evicting future policy entries. Episode time included extra repair-only diagnostics.
findings.verified_resolution: All actual episodes complete before diagnostic replay. Replay restores its own actor and creates a separate ExactBeliefDP. Actual and diagnostic cache_info are separately stored, with an assertion that replay leaves actual cache_info unchanged. Episode CPU and latency exclude replay and gzip writes. Actor CPU is controller plus estimator, reported separately from whole research-process receipts.

findings.original_problem: Summary was written before final source verification and did not independently reject incomplete or mismatched result identities.
findings.verified_resolution: summarize verifies sources before collecting and immediately before writing, rejects existing FAILURE, requires actual RESULT and PROCESS seed/domain/arm identities, exit zero, 128 episodes, current source-freeze identity and gzip SHA. Every full-clock worker must contain exactly the 6 by 27 registered arm/clock set with no duplicates, matching source/seed/domain, exit zero, leaf mass tolerance and recomputed means. Campaign exceptions retain FAILURE.

registered_scope.statistical_unit: Eight inherited paired fit seeds; domains, clocks, branches, episodes, prefixes and six arms do not create additional fitted-model replications.

remaining_scientific_limits: Source review is not execution evidence. The six behavior tests, source freeze, full 96-worker actual campaign and 16-worker full-clock campaign were not executed by this reviewer. Successful full receipts and unchanged reviewed SHA values are required before result claims.

Repair was motivated by earlier audit evidence. Fresh indexed tapes provide a subsequent fixed evaluation sample, but there is no new fitting, no fresh eight-fit replication and no multiplicity-controlled superiority test. Paired-fit t intervals are explicitly descriptive.

The complete-clock result is exact only for the registered finite model and finite clock support, subject to floating-point error. It does not establish a continuous-process first-passage approximation, moving-boundary validity, positive refractory-delay correctness or general-horizon scalability.

A local fitted base-tail score improvement does not guarantee improvement of the receding repaired policy in the true world. Ordinary actor probabilities need not equal fitted Bayesian posteriors. Base-tail scores must not be renamed repaired Qpi or repaired conditional regret.
All full future intervals are public experiment schedule information. This task does not validate a setting with unknown future observation arrival times.

A/C use the registered fixed-read lightweight baseline. This experiment does not establish dominance over all efficient or learned lightweight controllers, all stronger backbone families or natural multimodal content tasks.

mean_actor_cpu_seconds is controller plus estimator work within the fixed 128-episode process, including its particular cold-to-warm cache lifecycle. It is not a workload-independent latency guarantee. Episode timing additionally includes simulated owner and bookkeeping.

Whole-worker CPU and maximum RSS include retained episode traces, independent diagnostic replay/cache, serialization, imports and setup. RSS is a full research-process peak, not an isolated deployed actor memory peak. Full-clock computational costs are evaluator costs and must be presented separately.

READ, RESET and elapsed-time utility charges are declared synthetic task prices, not measured external service bills or joules. Device energy remains unknown/null. Historical training/preparation cost is inherited shared work, not incurred again for this repair.

No D-B advantage, broad content-learning benefit, foundation-core acceptance or quality-cost superiority can be inferred from this source review. Null/negative repair findings and the original audit evidence must be retained.
